purpose: Success counts that no data file can prove. Every resource cell on the project page is recomputed from a pinned CSV and checked against the paper's LaTeX by build/verify_tables.py. These Success counts cannot be checked that way: the denominator, the numerator, or both come from a human review of runs whose records are incomplete. They are published only on the authors' attestation, and this file is where that attestation is recorded and signed.
definition: A Success cell is ATTESTED when at least one of its two numbers cannot be derived from a pinned file: either a counted trial has no resource accounting in any analysis CSV, or the outcome is a human judgement transcribed by hand into an accounting script rather than measured. Where a pinned file happens to carry the same count, the gate says so, but the attestation stays the primary evidence.
how_the_page_states_this: Resource cells (time, tokens, cost) are machine-verified against the paper's own CSVs. Four Success denominators rest on author attestation: GPT-5.6 Terra, GPT-5.6 Luna and Claude Fable 5.1 in the model comparison, and the five GPT-6 Astra runs that built the experience store in the transfer study. The page says so beside each of them.
signoff_instructions: A named author fills in author_signoff.signed_by, author_signoff.date and author_signoff.statement for each entry, then runs: python3 build/verify_tables.py --require-signoff. The gate fails while any entry is unsigned.
signoff_taken: Signed on 2026-09-11 by Yang Lin, the author who ran every experiment (decision A4 in DECISIONS.md makes them the reviewer). Reviewed the review console (all 28 clips with their evidence sheets, findings and captions, and the four attested denominators) and approved all of them in a single decision on 2026-09-11. All four entries below therefore carry the same author, the same date and the same basis, because there was one decision and not four.

attested_success_denominators.row: Table 2, GPT-5.6 Terra (Codex, high effort), two pair assembly
attested_success_denominators.what_the_files_show: paper_runs/table2_metrics.csv carries all five trials with full time, token and cost accounting, and a success column reading 0, 0, 0, 1, 0. The one successful trial is trial 04.
attested_success_denominators.what_rests_on_attestation: The success column is not a measurement. It is a hand-maintained transcription, inside the accounting script's own batch table, of an operator's review of each trial's final overhead photo on 2026-09-10. Nothing in the session records determines the outcome, and trial 02's own report reads 'partial success, not task success' while trial 03's report states no outcome at all.
evidence: The accounting script's batch table records the operator review of 2026-09-10 that produced those flags.
Criterion: both demonstrated pairs assembled and still assembled after release and withdrawal.

attested_success_denominators.row: Table 2, GPT-5.6 Luna (Codex, high effort), two pair assembly
attested_success_denominators.what_the_files_show: No accounting file contains a Luna row at all: the paper prints an em dash for time, tokens and cost because no trial succeeded. Five sessions are on record.
attested_success_denominators.what_rests_on_attestation: Both numbers. Three of the five runs ended without a final report (one hit the time limit, two were aborted), so for those three the outcome is the reviewing author's reading of the last images, and the decision to count an aborted run as a counted failure rather than a void trial is also a judgement.
evidence: Trials 01 and 05 wrote a final report; both report failure.
Trial 02 hit the agent time limit and trials 03 and 04 were aborted; none of the three wrote a final report.
The batch records for this configuration list only a subset of the five trials, so the denominator of five comes from the session set plus the authors' count.

evidence: analysis/fable_table2/README.md: 'Success is 3/5 according to the user review supplied in this conversation. Trials 01 through 03 succeeded. Trials 04 and 05 failed. Trial 05 is included in the denominator based on the user report.'
Trial 05 started before trial 04 in wall-clock order and was relabelled afterwards; its session directory carries no final report.

not_attested_because_the_record_carries_.row: Experience transfer study, GPT-5.6 Terra reading the frozen store
not_attested_because_the_record_carries_.note: The batch record carries an explicit operator verdict for each of the five trials (success, success, fail, success, success), each with the remark that the after photo was checked. Two further runs of this batch are discarded infrastructure runs, are marked as such in the record, and are never counted or shown.

The audited success flag for all 37 trials is carried per trial in analysis/main_task_timing/table1_metrics.csv, so the gate recomputes both numbers of every Table 1 Success cell. The flags themselves are still human review; what distinguishes them from the entries above is that each counted trial has a row and a resource accounting on file.
